description: The authors publish Python code associated with comparing European built-up-area datasets for coastal-hazard exposure assessment. The parent collection explicitly states that the code extracts the low-elevation coastal zone and classifies settlement types from built-up-area datasets. Native file descriptors identify Python scripts for coastal-zone extraction, urban classification, zonal statistics and validation, alongside environment metadata and an unread README. The related data comprise coastal-zone and settlement-class rasters derived from GMIS, GHS-BUILT, ESM and WSF. The primary publication abstract describes sensitivity of exposed population and built-up area to settlement definitions. Figshare provides public free access under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is Europe with named regional study sites; this does not establish performance in every coastal region. The software prepares exposure-analysis inputs, while the existing raster collection is a separate data identity. A limitation is that no script, README, environment file or raster was read or executed. Internal parameters, deployment, interfaces and algorithm accuracy remain unverified.
